business_summary: Jiangsu Guofu Hydrogen Energy Equipment Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells hydrogen energy storage and transport equipment in the People's Republic of China. The company offers vehicle-mounted high-pressure hydrogen supply systems and related products that include components, such as hydrogen storage tanks, piping and valves, pressure/temperature sensors, and a control system. It also provides equipment for hydrogen refueling stations and related products; and comprehensive services comprising application scenario analysis, preliminary planning suggestions, product/selection comparative analysis, EPC, and maintenance and operation of hydrogen refueling stations, as well as intelligent operation and maintenance services. In addition, the company offers water electrolysis hydrogen production equipment and equipment for hydrogen liquefaction and the storage and transportation of liquid hydrogen. Further, it provides science and technology application services; e-commerce and commercial agency services; and renewable energy consultancy services. Additionally, the company engages in the international wholesale and retail trade of hydrogen energy products and equipment; and the research and experimental development of environmental and clean technologies. The company was formerly known as Zhangjiagang Furui Hydrogen Power Equipment Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Jiangsu Guofu Hydrogen Energy Equipment Co, LTD. in June 2019. Jiangsu Guofu Hydrogen Energy Equipment Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Zhangjiagang, China.
